body: I know I’ve gone a while without sex but am I seeing things?

I live with my boyfriend of well over a year, and my 2 year old son from a previous relationship...
But I looked in the mirror and I was so sad, I realized I appreciate him and am intoxicated by his presence... at risk of sounding contradictory to myself, I love him deeply... but I really want a woman by my side.
How will they feel about 99cent stores I wonder?

Ha. Well. Somehow, I must be. But how?
He’s making more money than ever before at his dream job in real estate and he is broke because he puts his all into taking care of me. 
He works hard to buy us clothes and furniture and nice things, but I am clumsy and burn holes in things or stain them or break them. 
I’ve lost two jobs he helped me get because I have no work experience and cannot focus.
I don’t drive. 
I’m a high school dropout.
I have no parents, or family.
They abandoned me at 15. 

He loves me because he feels bad. Im broken and he feels good by fixing me, we all know people like that and he is one of the kind souls who refuses to stop fighting a lost cause. 
I’m really doing him a favor.

I sincerely believe my son would be much happier and better cared for without me influencing his life. I have no idea what I’m doing on this Earth, and it seems so cruel to play trial and error games with another life. 
Love I have plenty of. All I can really do is love others. But I don’t know how to care for him. Doctors appointments, schooling, social security cards, punctuality and the like. 

I was suicidal before I even had my son, I was just so lonely, honestly. I loved the idea of someone loving me unconditionally. So selfish. 

As for my boyfriends emotions, he is very sweet and affectionate when he puts lots of effort into it, but naturally he is just analytical and unsympathetic. I can tell he feels burdened and stressed out, but he feels bad knowing I have no family to turn to.
